<b>Magma Bell</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. When equipped, it reduces damage from fire-based enemy attacks and environmental hazards.

== Usefulness ==
[[File:Screenshot SS Magma Bell Effect.png|Hornet being shielded from a pit of hot coals|left|thumb|200px]]

Magma Bell halves the {{Damage|2|type=Fire}} damage dealt by fire-based and lava-based attacks and hazards down to {{Damage|1|type=Fire}}. It also lets [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] touch hot floors and walls for an additional 2 seconds on top of the usual 0.7 seconds before taking damage. Hornet projects a red circle glowing with runes when Magma Bell is shielding her from a damage source, flashing into a fullscreen burst when it reduces a {{Damage|2|type=Fire}} injury.

Impacts that already deal {{Damage|1|type=Fire}} damage are ignored by the Bell, like small [[Flintstone]] rocks and [[Flintbeetle]] attacks.

It '''does not protect''' against [[Trobbio]]'s pyrotechnics.

When Magma Bell is active, a [[File:Magma Bell HUD Active.png|20x20px]] icon is displayed in the HUD. If Hornet takes protected damage or lingers on a hot surface for too long, the effect stops for a 5-second cooldown, indicated by a [[File:Magma Bell HUD Inactive.png|20x20px]] icon. When Magma Bell is ready again, the runic circle flashes around its icon and around Hornet.

{{Clear|left}}

Magma Bell is best used for situations where fiery attacks or lava hazards are expected:

* Areas full of [[Deep Docks|hot coals]] or [[Far Fields|lava pools]]
* Explosive ores found in [[the Marrow]] and [[Far Fields]]
* [[Lavalug]] and [[Lavalarga]]s' eruptions and death explosions
* [[Tarmite]]s' projectiles
* [[Flintflame Flyer]]s' projectiles and death explosions
* [[Cogwork Hauler]]s' explosions
* [[Lace]]'s lava arena
* [[Fourth Chorus]] and the second [[Savage Beastfly]]'s lava arena
* [[Last Judge]]'s flaming thurible attacks and death explosion
* [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron]]'s spear attacks and falling lava
* [[Wisp]]s' contact damage
* [[Burning Bug]]s' staff attacks and death immolation
* [[Father of the Flame]]'s ring of fire and death explosion

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Forge Daughter]] in [[Deep Docks]] for {{R|110}} and {{C|1}}.
